verdict.rationale: Lovable lets users export/sync their full generated codebase (frontend, backend schema, config) to GitHub/GitLab or download it directly, and database access via SQL editor allows data extraction — satisfying much of the 'export and leave' intent for code and schema. However, there's no dedicated bulk data export tool for underlying app data (rows/users/storage) in open formats, and community reports note vendor lock-in concerns (Supabase backend dependency), so full portability of live data isn't clearly evidenced.
